fixture: Passive ticks are paused. Fair arrivals supply 198 coins and trust is set to 45. k01/k02/k10 use the live arrival at 18:15 on day index 0 to preserve the exact Hijri date and countdowns. k05/k06/k07/k08/k09 stage the exact day at 10:00 from a reset clock with no prior misses. k10 sets the wallet to 10. k11 resets the clock after a fresh arrival and stages day index 0 at 10:00 so there are no prior misses. Resting is performed via the live buttons. No prayer totals or displayed text are seeded.
method: Native Godot viewport. Viewport clicks drive the fair arrival, the Inn calendar, both rest durations and the private prayer totals.
